name: Desire Flowers
source:
This game is a youthful romantic comedy where a protagonist, who's kind of wasting his youth, gets messed around by the unique heroines he meets at school, leading to a whole lot of slapstick chaos!

The protagonist quit his club, leaving a huge hole in his heart. But one day, he happens to stop by a room in the old school building, and from there, his youthful days kick back into gear.
Encounters with the heroines, school activities with an unusual group of members, and the overwhelmingly significant presence of a "witch" cause his and their stories to change at a dizzying pace.

The title "Desire" encapsulates the feelings of the heroines, each holding onto a desire to change themselves or a wish they want to make come true!
Being alive isn't just about fun; sometimes, you can't move forward unless you overcome the unavoidable realities you're confronted with.
Tears that won't stop even though you should be happy; a farewell declared for the sake of a better future, precisely because you love them.
The poignant feelings hidden deep within their hearts, the joy and sorrow, will clutch at the player's chest.
That kind of bittersweetness, and watching the characters grow stronger, are the charms of this game!

[From [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/5891020]Booth[/url]]
translation:
这是一部青春爱情喜剧，浪费青春的主角被学校里遇到的各具特色的女主角搞得一团糟，闹出一连串的闹剧！

主角退出了社团，心里留下了一个巨大的空洞。但有一天，他碰巧路过旧校舍的一间房间，从此，他的青春岁月又开始了。
与女主角的邂逅、与一群不寻常成员的学校活动，以及“女巫”压倒性的存在，导致他和她们的故事以令人眼花缭乱的速度发生变化。

《欲望》这个标题概括了女主角们的心情，每个人都怀揣着改变自己的愿望或者想要实现的愿望！
活着不只是为了好玩；有时，除非克服所面临的不可避免的现实，否则你无法前进。
明明应该幸福却止不住的泪水；告别是为了更好的未来，正是因为你爱他们。
隐藏在内心深处的凄美情感，喜怒哀乐，都会紧紧地揪在玩家的胸口。
那种苦乐参半，看着角色逐渐强大，就是这个游戏的魅力！

[来自[url=https://booth.pm/en/items/5891020]展位[/url]]
